OUR STORY / ARVIGA

A sense of space.
A mind for making.

Furniture shapes how we live. Engineering shapes how things work. At ARVIGA, we bring both perspectives to what we create.

Discover our approach ↓
THREE PARTNERS. A SHARED DIRECTION.

Good ideas deserve
to be well made.

ARVIGA is a new business bringing furniture, design and manufacturing together under one name.

As three partners, we share an ambition: to create useful products with a clear purpose, and to make the journey from an idea to a finished product more considered.

For furniture, that means thinking about the people, the space and everyday use. For engineering, it means understanding the application, the drawing and how the parts come together. Function is our starting point. Materials, proportions and construction bring it to life.

FROM THE FIRST SKETCH TO THE FINER DETAIL
HOW WE APPROACH YOUR BRIEF

Start with the purpose.
Work through the detail.

  1. 01

    Understand the need

    The space, application, quantity and budget help define what the product needs to do.

  2. 02

    Resolve the design

    Dimensions, materials, construction and finish are considered together, with practical trade-offs discussed early.

  3. 03

    Agree the scope

    Specifications, quotation, inspection and delivery requirements are agreed before work begins.

  4. 04

    Bring it together

    Manufacturing, finishing and assembly requirements follow the agreed design and project scope.

WHAT MATTERS TO US

The thinking behind
the finished thing.

01

Purpose before decoration

A useful product earns its place. Comfort, fit, access and everyday function should guide the design.

02

Details that work together

A material, a joint or a finish is part of a bigger picture. We consider how each choice affects the whole product.

03

Clarity from the beginning

A shared brief helps everyone move in the same direction. Requirements and decisions should be clear before a project progresses.
